blocks.heading: From mud to an empire
blocks.body:
Mattercraft asks what happens when a card game and clicker economy are combined with Little Alchemy. You begin with soil and mud, combine tools and materials, and gradually build a production system. The prototype made the crafting readable, but its only pressure came from managing an increasingly crowded field of cards.

In hindsight, it needed pushback: rats entering the system, furnaces consuming wood, cutters feeding tree production and relationships that gradually become a Factorio-like visual program. That missing pressure is the part I would explore if I return to it.
